description: Lightweight generic binary image blur classifier (sharpness quality gate for SealScan)

labels_description.0: Defocus blurred or motion blurred image (insufficient sharpness for inspection)
labels_description.1: Sharp / in-focus image (sufficient sharpness for seal analysis)

feature_descriptions.edge_strength: Mean magnitude of Sobel gradient vectors (sqrt(gx^2 + gy^2))
feature_descriptions.noise: Standard deviation of Gaussian residual (gray - GaussianBlur)
feature_descriptions.canny_edge_density: Proportion of edge pixels detected by Canny edge detector (100, 200)
feature_descriptions.fft_high_frequency_ratio: Ratio of high-frequency spectral energy to total energy in 2D FFT
feature_descriptions.blur_effect: Reblur / edge spread blur metric via skimage.measure.blur_effect

integration_spec.input: 7 numerical float features in exact feature_order (or image file path via extract_features_from_path)

output.discrete_prediction: BLURRY | NOT_BLURRY (based on default 0.5 or custom SealScan threshold)
